ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast; approximately 65% high-intensity white pixels and 35% low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central dark pigmentation spreading from the median notch in a wide 'V' shape, flanked by two large white contiguous regions. Multiple dark focal spots and short linear streaks are distributed across the white fields, particularly in the mid-left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with an approximate interior angle of 100 degrees; vertical depth from the highest points of the inner lobes is roughly 1/6th of the total visible fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the entire trailing edge; amplitude is greatest on the medial sections of the lobes, featuring deep, jagged notches and sharp peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge follows a generally concave trajectory from the median notch to the outer tips, with prominent upward-pointing distal lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct clusters of high-intensity white circular pixels (barnacles) localized at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions resembling rake marks visible on the lower-medial section of the left lobe's white surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular serration and potential tearing along the trailing edges; notable white parasitic or barnacle clusters on the dark tips.
other_distinctive_markers: A prominent, isolated dark pigmentation mark located in the upper-mid region of the left lobe's white area.
